_about: Predict & Win setup for BMSD 2026 Grand Finals. Load with: python scripts/predict_setup.py config/predict_bmsd2026.json

settings.prize: Top 5 on the overall leaderboard win a gift card of their choice.

team_logos._note: Files in static/teamlogos/<KEY>.webp, KEY = team name in capitals without spaces. Source: Light logo pack.

creates: Champion (team tiles, closes Day 3 2:45 PM IST)
Day 1 peak viewers (auto-settles from the tracker)

rules: Free to play. No money, no bets.
Each pick saves automatically and can't be changed.
Right pick = 100 points, plus up to 100 bonus if few people got it right.
Top 3 and BMIC: points for each team you got right.
Top 5 overall after the finals (Sun 18 Oct) win a gift card. Ties go to whoever joined first.
One Instagram ID per person. Fake accounts are removed.

switches.PREDICT_OPEN: set to 1 in .env to show the Predict & Win banner on the live site
